_about: Every move there is: the lab moves (lab/moves/<id>) any style can call, and the ve engine devices, listed so there is one inventory. Written by node lab/moves/check.mjs --write.

moves.what: A row of small bars grows, then the new ones grow in the series colour.
A cost bar shrinks with a mint arrow: something got cheaper.
A number counts to the spoken value in a card, then to the new value with the old one struck; a row of people lights and the leavers drop away.
The parts of one object light one by one to the spoken number; the leavers go dark on the drop; everything dims and returns.
A person at work at a counter acts the line out: a machine arrives, the person appears, hands something over; returns as a ghost and comes back; turns from the task to people.
A captured source page on a paper card: a hand-drawn circle (or underline) draws round the line that matters, then a loupe lifts the same pixels to twice their size.
A mint bar draws across the ground: held level.
One giant number rises out of a dark stage floor, a slow band of light sweeps across its face, and its reflection fades into the floor.
A chart draws itself: an expected line dives, the real lines draw with glowing heads, and on "watch" one turns mint and pulses.
Pins drop onto a street grid with ripples: the first group, then the new ones in the series colour.
A percentage counts up on a block of the series colour wiping in under it.
Two rows of people, an equals sign and a level line: the total stayed the same.
Two towers of slabs, the two things that moved: one loses slabs that fall under gravity, one gains slabs that drop on.
Every source pinned to one timeline: year ticks, a pin drops at each source's moment as he says it, a playhead walks to the year being spoken about.
Copies of the object rise into a street, then the new ones drop in from above: a percentage made visible.
One task ticks done, then the freed time opens as new slots.
One slab lifts off a tower, turns mint and makes four copies in the space it freed.
Where time goes: one task bar shrinks, another grows; pairs of people appear, each with a bubble.
A notification slides in for each number.
A word or number set huge on the grid, revealed by a mask from its baseline or from the left, held, then pushed out; optional strike and a solid block behind.
